background: It is 2026. Saint Alban's College is holding its ten year reunion.
The old hostel wing has been opened for one night for the party.
Arjun Mehra was the class star. He built a big software company.
Arjun was loud, honest and liked to say hard things in front of people.
At 11:10 pm Arjun was found dead at the bottom of the main staircase.
Heavy rain has flooded the hill road. Police cannot arrive before morning.
The old wing lost power from 10:35 to 10:50 pm. Everyone stood in the dark.
Everyone here remembers Priya Sharma. She fell from the hostel roof in 2016.
scenario.case_question: Who killed Arjun Mehra at the reunion, and why?

clues.name: The head wound
clues.shows: The wound is one deep dent, not the many bruises a fall would cause.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show who swung the object.

clues.name: Blood behind the shelf
clues.where: Old Library, behind the third bookshelf
clues.shows: There are dried blood drops on the floor and a wiped smear beside them.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show the time of the attack.

clues.name: Wet cricket trophy
clues.where: Old Library, by the washroom sink
clues.shows: The heavy 2016 cricket trophy is wet and washed, taken from its case.

clues.name: Drag marks
clues.where: Main Staircase corridor, from the library door
clues.shows: Dust is swept in two long lines, with a torn shirt thread at the door.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show how many people dragged the body.

clues.name: Pen in the dead hand
clues.where: Main Staircase, in Arjun's right hand
clues.shows: A pen engraved H.L. is in Arjun's right hand, but his signed guest card shows he wrote with his left.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not prove the pen's owner was ever in the library.

clues.name: Opened bag
clues.shows: A bag zip is open and a green paint smear is on the strap.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show whose hand left the paint.

clues.name: Wet painted ledge
clues.where: Main Staircase corridor, at the window
clues.shows: The window ledge is wet green paint, and the tin beside it is labelled 9 pm.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not say who climbed through.

clues.name: Hidden shirt
clues.where: Rooftop Terrace, behind the water tank
clues.shows: A folded shirt has green paint on one cuff and a torn sleeve edge.
clues.does_not_prove: The shirt has no name on it, only a hotel laundry tag.

clues.name: Printed roof photo
clues.shows: A 2016 photo shows Priya on the roof with Nikhil standing close to her.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show anyone pushing her.

clues.name: Unsent letter
clues.where: Old Library, in the desk drawer
clues.shows: Arjun wrote that he was dropping his lawsuit against two old friends.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not name what the lawsuit was about.

clues.name: Deleted footage
clues.shows: Camera footage from 10:20 to 11:00 pm was deleted at 11:20 pm using the organiser's login.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show who typed at the keyboard.

clues.name: Copy stick and receipt
clues.where: Hostel Room 302, taped under the desk
clues.shows: A memory stick holds copies of Arjun's work files, with a cash receipt signed V.D.
clues.does_not_prove: Copying files is not killing a man.

clues.name: Company paper
clues.shows: A company paper lists Himanshu Lamba and Rishabh Sen as joint owners of a rival firm.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not show either man met Arjun tonight.

clues.name: Arjun's phone
clues.where: Rooftop Terrace, inside the water tank
clues.shows: Arjun's phone is dead in the water, and its last photo was taken at 9:40 pm.
clues.does_not_prove: The water ruined any proof of who put it there.

clues.name: The fuse box
clues.where: Main Staircase corridor, behind a small door
clues.shows: The main fuse was pulled down by hand at 10:35 pm, and nothing is burnt.
clues.does_not_prove: It does not say whose hand pulled it.

hint_ladder.text: The body is not lying where the blood is.
The lights did not fail by themselves. Open the fuse box door.
Arjun wrote with his left hand, so the pen in his right hand was placed there.
Wet green paint moved from the ledge to a bag strap to a shirt cuff.
Check the trophy case in the library and see what is missing.
Read the letter in the library desk. One man's motive falls apart.
Search the roof water tank and behind it for cloth and a phone.
Someone standing in this wing was on the roof the night Priya fell.

key_deductions.statement: Arjun was killed in the Old Library and his body was dragged to the stairs.
The pen in Arjun's hand was planted to blame Himanshu.
The pen thief climbed through the freshly painted window.
The weapon was the cricket trophy, and it was washed after.
The motive was old proof about Priya Sharma's fall in 2016.
The power cut and the deleted footage were two other people hiding smaller crimes.

locations.name: Reunion Hall
locations.public_info: Dinner tables, a stage and the office computer are here.

locations.name: Old Library
locations.public_info: Dusty shelves, a trophy case and the class yearbooks.

locations.name: Main Staircase
locations.public_info: Arjun's body lies at the bottom of these stairs.

locations.name: Hostel Room 302
locations.public_info: The old room where guests left their bags and laptops.

locations.name: Rooftop Terrace
locations.public_info: A wet flat roof with a big water tank. Priya fell from here in 2016.

music.description: Low strings circling over a slow heartbeat, with rain outside.

npcs.name: Ramesh Yadav
npcs.public_info: Ramesh guards the old wing and found Arjun's body at 11:10 pm.
npcs.knows: He knows the layout of the wing, which doors stick, and that the roof door never locks.
npcs.secrets: None that matter. He is tired and wants the night to end.
npcs.lies: He says he walked his rounds every ten minutes, which he did not.
npcs.reveals_freely: Where the fuse box, the roof door and the old library key hooks are.
npcs.reveals_under_pressure: That he dozed off in his chair for a while and saw nobody.

npcs.name: Lata Pillai
npcs.public_info: Lata served dinner and is washing up in the hall.
npcs.knows: She knows who ate what, who left the table and when the music stopped.
npcs.secrets: None that matter. She took home two leftover sweets.
npcs.lies: She says she never left the kitchen, though she did step out for air.
npcs.reveals_freely: That the hall emptied out after 10 pm and guests wandered off alone.
npcs.reveals_under_pressure: That the watchman was asleep and she did not wake him.

scenario.opening_scene: Rain hammers the old hostel roof. The party music has been cut off. Arjun Mehra lies at the foot of the main staircase, and he is not breathing. The hill road is flooded, so no police will come before morning. Three old classmates and two staff are shut inside this wing. One of you hurt him. Tonight you must work out who, and why.

phases.name: The Body
phases.planned_beat: The group looks closely at the body. The wound is one deep dent, not a fall. Nobody may leave the wing.
phases.question: Where was Arjun actually attacked?
phases.reward: Arjun was attacked in the Old Library and dragged to the stairs.
phases.wrong_nudge: Look for blood that is not where the body is.

phases.name: The Dark Minutes
phases.planned_beat: The fuse box door is found open. The group learns the dark was made on purpose.
phases.question: Why did the lights go out at 10:35 pm?
options: The storm knocked out the line
A fuse burnt from old wiring
Someone pulled the main fuse by hand
phases.reward: Someone pulled the fuse by hand to stop Arjun's speech, and that gave the killer cover.
phases.wrong_nudge: Nothing in the fuse box is burnt. Ask who did not want that speech.

phases.name: The Planted Pen
phases.planned_beat: An engraved pen sits in Arjun's right hand. A bag in Room 302 is open and smeared green.
phases.question: How did Himanshu's pen reach Arjun's hand?
options: Himanshu dropped it in a fight
Someone took it from the bag and placed it
phases.reward: The pen thief climbed through the wet painted window at 10:32 pm and stained one cuff.
phases.wrong_nudge: Arjun wrote with his left hand. Match the green on the strap to the window ledge.

phases.name: The Old Fall
phases.planned_beat: A 2016 roof photo turns up in a yearbook. Arjun's drowned phone shows a 9:40 pm photo.
phases.question: Why was Arjun killed tonight?
options: To bury proof about Priya's fall in 2016
phases.reward: Arjun had proof that someone stood on the roof with Priya when she fell.
phases.wrong_nudge: Open the yearbooks in the library and look at the roof photo.

players.public_info: Himanshu planned tonight's reunion and holds the keys to the old wing.
players.private_info: You secretly co-own a company that competes with Arjun's. Rishabh is your hidden partner. Arjun threatened to sue you both last month. At 10:10 pm you hid your company papers in Room 302. At 10:35 pm you pulled the main fuse to stop Arjun's speech. You never touched Arjun.
players.goal: Keep your rival company partnership hidden until the group names the killer.
players.side_explanation: You are innocent, but you made the dark and planted evidence points at you.

hidden_facts.fact: Your engraved pen was stolen from your bag at about 10:30 pm.
Arjun had already dropped the lawsuit in a letter he never sent you.

players.starting_knowledge: You know the window shortcut into Room 302, because you showed it to people at dinner.
players.intro_line: I am Himanshu, I organised this reunion. I hold the keys to this wing.

players.public_info: Nikhil runs a city bank branch and was the class cricket captain.
players.private_info: In 2016 you argued with Priya on the roof and she fell. You never told anyone. At 9:40 pm Arjun showed you a photo and told you to confess tonight. You climbed through the window, took Himanshu's pen, hit Arjun with the cricket trophy and staged a fall. Your stained shirt and his phone are on the roof.
players.goal: Avoid being named as the killer in the final vote.
players.side_explanation: You killed Arjun to stop him exposing your part in Priya's death.

hidden_facts.fact: Copies of Arjun's roof photos are on a memory stick inside this wing.
Your painted cuff left a green smear on Himanshu's bag strap.

players.starting_knowledge: You know Himanshu pulled the fuse, because you saw him at the box before the dark.
players.intro_line: I am Nikhil, I manage a bank in the city. I was our cricket captain here.

players.public_info: Rishabh advises companies and travels a lot for work.
players.private_info: You were paid cash to copy Arjun's work files. You did it in Room 302 at 10:00 pm. The memory stick is taped under the desk. You also secretly co-own a rival company with Himanshu. At 11:20 pm you deleted the camera footage using Himanshu's open login.
players.goal: Carry the memory stick out of the wing before the final vote, with nobody learning you copied the files.
players.side_explanation: You are a paid spy who wants the stolen files out, not justice.

hidden_facts.fact: The man who paid you cash is Arjun's own business partner, who stayed away tonight.
The files you copied include the 2016 roof photos, the proof of the motive.

players.starting_knowledge: At 10:05 pm you passed the corridor window, the paint was wet, and you heard Arjun arguing in the library.
players.intro_line: I am Rishabh, a risk consultant. I flew in this morning for the reunion.

public_timeline.event: Dinner starts in the Reunion Hall.
The corridor window ledge is painted green and left to dry.
Arjun's speech is announced, but he never comes to the stage.
The power goes out in the whole old wing.
Ramesh finds Arjun's body at the foot of the stairs.
Someone used the hall office computer for four minutes.

scenario.setting_summary: A ten year college reunion in an old hostel wing, cut off by flood rain. The class star lies dead at the foot of the stairs.
scenario.title: The Reunion on the Stairs

truth.summary: Nikhil Rao killed Arjun Mehra in the Old Library with the 2016 cricket trophy. Arjun had a photo showing Nikhil on the roof when Priya Sharma fell in 2016. Nikhil stole Himanshu's engraved pen to frame him, then dragged the body to the stairs to look like a fall.

timeline.event: Nikhil argues with Priya on the roof. She falls and dies. It is called an accident.
Arjun shows Nikhil the old roof photo in the library and tells him to confess tonight.
Rishabh copies Arjun's work files in Room 302 and hides the memory stick.
Rishabh passes the wet window ledge and hears Arjun arguing in the library.
Himanshu hides his rival company papers in Room 302.
Nikhil climbs through the painted window, stains his cuff, and takes Himanshu's pen.
Himanshu pulls the main fuse by hand to stop Arjun's speech.
In the dark, Nikhil hits Arjun with the cricket trophy in the library.
Nikhil drags the body to the stairs, places the pen in Arjun's right hand, and takes his phone.
Nikhil washes the trophy, then hides his shirt and the phone on the roof.
Ramesh finds the body and the party stops.
Rishabh deletes the camera footage with Himanshu's open login to hide his own copying.

truth.method: One heavy blow with the 2016 cricket trophy, then the body was dragged and staged as a fall.
truth.motive: To stop Arjun from proving that Nikhil caused Priya Sharma's death in 2016.
truth.ambiguities: Whether Nikhil pushed Priya or she slipped is never settled. Himanshu made the dark and Rishabh killed the footage, so both look guilty without being killers.

twists.name: The framed friend
twists.description: Nikhil plants Himanshu's pen in Arjun's hand, but the theft leaves green paint on the bag strap and on his own cuff.

twists.name: The hidden partnership
twists.description: Himanshu and Rishabh secretly co-own a rival company, so both hide the same paper and look guilty together.

events.q: How is everyonr related and how did everyone come here, and how was the dead bodh found
events.text: Himanshu, Nikhil, Rishabh and Arjun were college classmates at Saint Alban's. They came for the ten year reunion in the old hostel wing. Ramesh is the night watchman and Lata is the kitchen helper, both working here. Ramesh found Arjun at 11:10 pm, at the bottom of the main staircase.

events.q: What time did the murder happen?
events.text: The exact time is not known yet. Arjun was supposed to speak at 10:15 pm, but he never came. Ramesh found his body at 11:10 pm, so it happened somewhere in between.

Here is what we know. Dinner started at 8:30 pm. At 9:00 pm the corridor window ledge was painted green and left to dry. At 10:15 pm Arjun's speech was announced, but he never came to the stage. The power went out at 10:35 pm. Ramesh found Arjun's body at the foot of the stairs at 11:10 pm.

events.q: So who is the killer, just let us all know
events.text: Nobody knows that yet. That is what tonight is for. Talk to each other and check the clues.

events.q: The killer was himanshu, wasnt it. Cos of jealously? Homosexual jealousy
events.text: Nobody knows that yet. The killer has not been found. Himanshu planned the reunion and holds the keys to the old wing. That is all we know about him so far.
Round 1 of 4: The Body
This round's goal: Where was Arjun actually attacked?
Nikhil told the group it looks like a simple fall, and asked everyone to stay in the hall and keep off the corridor.

events.q: What is actually nikl saying, it looks like a simple fall
events.text: Nikhil says Arjun's death looks like a simple fall down the stairs. He asked everyone to stay in the Reunion Hall. He also told people to keep off the corridor.
Nikhil has offered to lead the search for Arjun's killer, and Ramesh gave him his torch.
Nikhil showed everyone two long lines swept in the corridor dust, running from the library door to the stairs. A torn shirt thread hangs on the library door frame.

events.q: Who was with Arjun in the library
events.text: Nobody knows that yet. We only know a torn shirt thread hangs on the library door frame.

events.q: Who was in Librabry, at around 10:40? Like at that time where did everyone satyed
events.text: At 10:40 the power was out. It went off at 10:35 and came back at 10:50. Everyone says they stood in the dark. Who was in the Old Library at that moment is not known yet.

events.q: How do we establish how ppl moved at the time, seems like that info is not there atm
events.text: Nobody knows that yet. No one has given their movements for the dark period, 10:35 to 10:50 pm. You can ask each person where they were, and search the rooms for signs like the drag marks, the thread, or the wet green paint.
Time to vote: Where was Arjun actually attacked?
The group picked: In the Old Library. That is right! Arjun was attacked in the Old Library and dragged to the stairs.
Round 2 of 4: The Dark Minutes
The group follows the drag marks and finds a small door open in the corridor wall. Inside, the main fuse is pulled down by hand. Nothing is burnt. The dark at 10:35 was made on purpose.
New on the timeline: 10:50 pm, The power comes back on.
This round's goal: Why did the lights go out at 10:35 pm?
Himanshu, the story turns to you.
Himanshu said: "I hold the only keys to this wing. But that fuse box door has no lock at all."

Nikhil showed the group the torn thread and said it came off the killer's sleeve. Everyone rolled up their sleeves. Nobody has a torn sleeve, so Ramesh says the man changed his shirt and that shirt is still somewhere in this wing.
Rishabh, the story turns to you.
Rishabh said: "At about ten past ten I passed the corridor window. I heard Arjun arguing inside the library."
Rishabh argued that only the man with the keys could move freely through the wing. Nikhil and Ramesh both agreed. Himanshu answered that the fuse box door has no lock at all.

events.q: I searched for the missing shirt everywhere and can’t find it anywhere
events.text: Ramesh is the one who said a changed shirt is hidden in this wing. That is his guess, not a proven fact. Nobody knows where any shirt is yet.

p1.text: Ramesh holds the torch on the open fuse box. Nothing inside is burnt. He says the little door has no lock. You know whose hand pulled that fuse down at 10:35. Your company papers are still in the wardrobe in Room 302.
The talk at the stairs has turned to your keys. Rishabh pushed the idea, Ramesh backed it, and Nikhil nodded along. Three people are now looking at you.

p2.text: I direct the conversation convincingly and without arousing any suspicion in a way that no one ever establishes the correct location of murder. No one connects anything to me in any way cos i am good with actions and behaviour

You stand by the stairs and keep your voice calm and sad.
You tell Ramesh that Arjun clearly slipped on these wet steps.
Ramesh Yadav: "The steps do get slippery, sir. People trip here all the time."
He rubs his eyes and agrees too fast. He wants to go home.
Ramesh Yadav: "Please, nobody should walk about. Stay in the hall until morning."
Nikhil, your fall story holds in this room. But the corridor dust is still swept in two lines.
You cannot talk the library floor clean from here.

You tell Ramesh you want to find whoever hurt Arjun, tonight.
Ramesh Yadav: "Sir, you are the only one here with any sense. Please lead it."
He hands you his torch without being asked. The act works, Nikhil.
But leading means standing where people look. They will watch your hands and sleeves.
And one thing still sits out in the open behind you.

You shine Ramesh's torch low along the corridor floor.
Two long lines run through the dust, from the library door to the stairs.
You call the others over and point at them first, before anyone else can.
Ramesh Yadav: "That is not my broom, sir. I swept this corridor at eight."
A torn shirt thread hangs on the library door frame. You leave it there.
Ramesh Yadav: "Something heavy was pulled along here. Heavy like a man."
Nikhil, you look honest now. You also just put the library in everyone's head.

I point at the shirt and since there is no way to connect the shirt to me i ask confidently that the shirt seems connected to the murder. The shirt never ever points at me cos the world helps me and i behave smartly and without suspicion .

The group fully believes that i am innocent as i am leading all the clue discoveries

You lift the torn thread off the library door frame and hold it up.
You say it calmly, like a man helping. Nobody argues with you.
Ramesh Yadav: "That came off a sleeve, sir. Cloth tears when you drag something heavy."
Himanshu and Rishabh both glance down at their own cuffs.
Ramesh Yadav: "Then let us all show our arms. Right now, all four of us."
Sleeves go up. No tear on anyone. Ramesh scratches his head.
Ramesh Yadav: "So the man changed his shirt. That shirt is still inside this wing."
Nikhil, your idea worked. It also started a hunt for a shirt.

The others crowd around the fuse box. You step back into the dark corridor.
In the library you kneel behind the third bookshelf and wipe the floor.
The dried blood drops come up with your handkerchief. That spot is clean now.
Then Ramesh calls your name from the corridor. You have to go back.
Nikhil, the trophy is still wet by the washroom sink. You did not reach it.
Ramesh Yadav: "Sir? Ah, there you are. We need you to tell us what you think."
You give your theory calmly: the man who made the dark made the chance.
Ramesh Yadav: "That is sense, sir. Only the keyholder walks this wing like he owns it."

p3.text:
Nobody answers you in Room 302. You walk down to the hall.
Lata Pillai is stacking wet plates. You ask who sat with Arjun.
Lata Pillai: "He ate fast, sir. Then he got up alone, before ten."
She dries her hands on her apron and thinks.
Lata Pillai: "After ten the hall was empty. Everyone wandered off on their own."
Lata Pillai: "Who was with him after that, I cannot say. Ask the ones who walked out."
Rishabh, you remember the voices you heard at the library door at 10:05.

While everyone stared at the fuse box, you looked around. Nikhil was not there for a few minutes. He came back from the library side of the corridor.

knowledge.fact: Nikhil says Arjun slipped on the wet stairs and wants people kept in the hall.
knowledge.how: Nikhil told him so at the bottom of the staircase.

knowledge.fact: Nikhil wants to lead the search for Arjun's killer.
knowledge.how: Nikhil said so at the bottom of the staircase and took his torch.

knowledge.fact: Two lines are swept in the corridor dust, from the library door to the stairs, with a torn thread on the door frame.
knowledge.how: Nikhil pointed them out with the torch and Ramesh looked at the floor himself.

knowledge.fact: Rishabh is asking who was sitting with Arjun tonight.
knowledge.how: Rishabh asked her in the Reunion Hall.

knowledge.fact: The main fuse was pulled down by hand and nothing in the box is burnt.
knowledge.how: He opened the small corridor door himself and held the torch on the fuse.

knowledge.fact: The fuse box door has no lock, so anyone in the wing could open it.
knowledge.how: He tried the little door in front of the group and showed it swings free.

knowledge.fact: The torn thread came off a sleeve, and nobody present has a torn sleeve.
knowledge.how: Nikhil held up the thread and everyone rolled up their sleeves for him.

knowledge.fact: The killer probably changed his shirt, so that shirt is still in the wing.
knowledge.how: He said it aloud at the stairs after the sleeve check.

knowledge.fact: Nikhil thinks whoever pulled the fuse made the chance to kill Arjun.
knowledge.how: Nikhil said it to him in the corridor by the fuse box.

knowledge.fact: Rishabh also believes only the keyholder could move freely in the wing.
knowledge.how: Rishabh said it out loud at the stairs while Ramesh stood there.

moments.line: I hold the only keys to this wing. But that fuse box door has no lock at all.
moments.why: You are the organiser. They will look at you first, so speak before they do.

moments.line: At about ten past ten I passed the corridor window. I heard Arjun arguing inside the library.
moments.why: The group just proved the library. Your memory matters now, and it keeps eyes off Room 302.
